title: drosera peltata subsp. auriculata
intro: Drosera peltata subsp. auriculata, commonly known as the "Golden Sundew," is a species of carnivorous plant belonging to the Droseraceae family. This plant is known for its unique ability to capture and digest insects to supplement its nutrient deficiency in nutrient-poor soils. The health benefits of Drosera peltata subsp. auriculata include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate respiratory issues and boost the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoid glycosides and phenolic acids, which are thought to exhibit sedative and expectorant properties.
